kebab_example: aliyun adb start-spark-sql-engine --db-cluster-id amv-abcd0000 --resource-group-name spark-rg-name --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartSparkSQLEngine

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_name

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of executors that are required to execute SQL statements. Valid values: 0 to 2000. A value of 0 indicates that no executors are permanent if no SQL statements are executed. If this value exceeds the total number of executors that are supported by the resource group, the Spark SQL engine fails to be started. The value must be less than the value of MaxExecutor
parameters.help_zh: 执行SQL时拉起的最小Exectuor数量，配置为0意味着当不需要执行SQL时不会常驻Exectuor。取值范围为0到2000，当配置数量超过资源组承载总量时会导致服务启动失败。此处配置值必须小于MaxExecutor的配置值
parameters.name: min_executor

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of executors that are required to execute SQL statements. Valid values: 1 to 2000. If this value exceeds the total number of executes that are supported by the resource group, the Spark SQL engine fails to be started
parameters.help_zh: 执行SQL时启动的最大的Exector数量。取值范围为1到2000，当配置数量超过资源组承载总量时会导致服务启动失败
parameters.name: max_executor

parameters.help_en: The Object Storage Service (OSS) paths of third-party JAR packages that are required to start the Spark SQL engine. Separate multiple OSS paths with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 启动SQL引擎时需要引入的第三方JAR包列表，以逗号分隔的JAR包所在的OSS地址
parameters.name: jars

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of slots that are required to maintain Spark sessions for executing SQL statements. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 最大槽位数，即最多可以维持多少个Spark Session来执行SQL。取值范围为1到500
parameters.name: slot_num

parameters.help_en: The configuration that is required to start the Spark SQL engine. Specify this value in the JSON format. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471203.html
parameters.help_zh: 启动Spark SQL Engine的具体配置，以一个JSON来描述KEY-VALUE型配置信息。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471203.html
parameters.name: config

AppId.description_en: The ID of the Spark job

AppName.description_en: The name of the Spark application

State.description_en:
The state of the Spark SQL engine. Valid values:

SUBMITTED
STARTING
RUNNING
FAILED
State.description_zh:
Spark SQL Engine状态：

SUBMITTED：提交启动请求。
STARTING：启动中。
RUNNING：运行中，可以执行SQL。
FAILED：引擎出错退出
